Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a display device coupled to a set-top terminal, wherein the display occurs only after the filtering step is completed and the filtered EPG information is verified to contain only programs from channels within the subscriber's channel accessibility__.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __by accessing subscriber-specific authorization data maintained separately from the EPG provider__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __through a secure communication channel distinct from the EPG provider's data transmission path__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __wherein the list is generated and maintained by a processor separate from the EPG provider's systems__.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information __received from the EPG provider__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information __using a conditional access processor__; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __and storing the filtered results in a local memory buffer before display__.

Claim 6 (Original): The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider __wherein the EPG information is retrieved via a tuner module__; and filtering the EPG information to retain program information related to programs delivered by a content delivery provider to a subscriber, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider __wherein the filtering is performed by a processor module that applies subscriber-specific authorization criteria not derived from the EPG provider__.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on an on-screen menu interface after verification that all displayed programs are within the subscriber's authorized channel list__.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __by retrieving subscriber-specific authorization information from a source independent of the EPG provider__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __through a dedicated secure channel separate from EPG data transmission__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __wherein the list is generated and stored locally by the machine independent of the EPG provider's systems__.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information __from the EPG provider's data stream__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information __using a conditional access processor module__; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __and caching the filtered results in a local buffer__.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information __on an on-screen menu interface, wherein display occurs only after the filtering module has completed removal of inaccessible channels and the filtered results have been verified__.
